messages.subject: Project Drake — completion checklist & signing plan
messages.plaintextBody:
Team — let's lock the completion mechanics. We'll run a virtual signing on 14 November. Required: members' written resolutions (articles + allotment + disapplication), board minutes, executed subscription agreement, IRA, side letter, adopted articles, disclosure letter, updated register of members, SH01. Elena to prepare the signing pack and bring-down; James to manage funds flow with the bank.

Let's have everything in agreed form by 12 November.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Corporate
